FN-UYPPGGD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 131
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Mack Butler
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/16/2024
House Bill 131 as introduced would require health care providers seeking an exemption from
sales and use tax for certain durable medical equipment and medical supplies to file a certificate
of exemption with the Alabama Department of Revenue. This bill would also limit the time
period that a health care provider may seek a refund of taxes paid to 12 months from the date of
the sale.

FN-UYPPGGD-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 131
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Mack Butler
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/21/2024
House Bill 131 as reported by the Committee on State Government would require health care
providers seeking an exemption from sales and use tax for certain durable medical equipment
and medical supplies to obtain and maintain a certificate of exemption with the Alabama
Department of Revenue, prior to any such purchase.
